none: PAS NLM-9BC7F0: Roman Coin: Denarius of Julia Soaemias
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Denarius of Julia Soaemias (218-222), probably RIC volume 4 part 2 no. 234. Obverse description: Bust coiffed and draped right. Obverse inscription: IVLIASOAEMI[AS] AVG. Reverse description: Female figure standing left holding cornucopiae, object to left resembles scales (RIC describes a modius here). Reverse inscription: [ANNON]A AVG. Diameter: 18.9mm, Weight: 2.62gms, die axis: 12
